subject.title: improve(sqlite): prove abrupt writer crash recovery

question: Should an SQLite-area owner complete the source and cross-platform review of this maintainer-authored reliability-proof change before it lands?
rationale: The protected maintainer label requires explicit maintainer handling, and the review sandbox prevented the required source, policy, history, and exact-diff inspection.

options.title: Rerun the technical review
options.body: Review the exact head in a functioning read-only environment, including writer shutdown semantics and the reported Testbox evidence.

options.title: Perform owner review directly
options.body: An SQLite-area contributor may validate the harness invariant and cross-platform process behavior manually.

recommendation.title: Rerun the technical review
recommendation.body: Review the exact head in a functioning read-only environment, including writer shutdown semantics and the reported Testbox evidence.
